title: Emergence of Tsallis Statistics from a Self-Referential Nonlinear Operator: A Variational Framework
summary: We develop a variational thermodynamic framework for statistical systems governed by a self-referential nonlinear operator Omega characterized by structural exponents alpha > 0, beta >= 0, a symmetric kernel K, and a self-coupling constant kappa >= 0. The central object is the self-consistency entropy S[Psi] = -D_KL(Psi || Omega Psi), which vanishes at the fixed points of Omega and serves as a natural Lyapunov functional.
